knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson cites the NSW work at heights page for the scaffold licence threshold at more than 4 metres. The 2 metre SWMS trigger is a different duty.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a scaffold scenario and the candidate separates the 2 metre SWMS duty from the 4 metre licence threshold
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Completing the add-on grants no licence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor note on any licence or authority claim made by the candidate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate applies the scaffold licence threshold at 2 metres without a source
